words.example: The hearing will be held in the building opposite the main lobby.
words.exampleZh: 听证会在主大厅对面的那栋楼宇里举行。

words.example: Registration moved into the east wing while this side is renovated.
words.exampleZh: 这边装修期间，挂号搬到了东侧楼翼。

words.example: Visitors heading to the ward sign in at the nurses' station first.
words.exampleZh: 要去病区的探视者，请先到护士站登记。

words.example: The day surgery unit closes its counter at five on weekdays.
words.exampleZh: 日间手术单元的柜台在工作日五点关闭。

words.example: Families should wait outside bay three while the doctors are rounding.
words.exampleZh: 医生查房的时候，家属请在三号床位区外面等候。

words.example: An instant clone of the training desktop was ready before the class sat down.
words.exampleZh: 上课入座之前，培训桌面的即时克隆就已经好了。

words.example: vMotion moved the HIS VM off the failing host without dropping the clinic sessions.
words.exampleZh: 在线迁移把 HIS 虚拟机挪离了那台故障主机，门诊会话没有断。

words.example: Storage vMotion is moving the HIS disks onto the new array while users stay connected.
words.exampleZh: 存储在线迁移正在把 HIS 磁盘迁到新阵列，用户保持连接。

words.example: The HA cluster restarted the HIS VM on another host after host two died.
words.exampleZh: 二号主机宕了之后，高可用集群在另一台主机上把 HIS 虚拟机拉了起来。

words.meaning: 动态资源调度（Distributed Resource Scheduler）
words.example: DRS (Distributed Resource Scheduler) moved a noisy lab VM off the host that runs HIS.
words.exampleZh: DRS（动态资源调度）把一台抢资源的检验虚拟机挪离了跑 HIS 的主机。
